HOME
Welcome to Archer’s Gulf Serenity Spa!

Located @Kneading Relief in Gulf Shores, AL.

Step into a space dedicated to your well-being. From soothing massages and rejuvenating facials to luxurious scalp treatments — we’re here to help you feel renewed and refreshed. let us guide you on your journey to ultimate relaxation and self-care.

What we do

We specialize in a variety of massage modalities, tailored to your unique needs. Enhance your experience with the soothing benefits of dōTERRA essential oils or the deep relaxation of hot stones, available with most of our services. Our mission is to help you find relief from life’s stresses and aches through therapeutic touch. We take pride in creating a calm, relaxing, safe, and clean environment for every client.

Facial Treatments

Whether you’re seeking a customized facial, a rejuvenating microdermabrasion, or a refreshing hydrafacial, you’re in the best hands with our skilled and licensed cosmetologist.

Your skin is your daily canvas, and we’re here to help it shine with confidence. Let us pamper you with a treatment tailored to your unique needs, leaving your skin looking radiant, refreshed, and revitalized.

Japanese Head Spa

Our Japanese Head Spa offers a soothing experience that combines a relaxing scalp massage with the calming effects of dōTERRA’s Shinrin-Yoku essential oil blend. This treatment is designed to relieve tension, enhance scalp health, and promote relaxation through steam therapy and gentle techniques. It’s the perfect way to unwind and connect with nature’s healing properties.

Focused on both mental and physical wellness, the Japanese Head Spa improves circulation to the scalp and helps nourish hair health. Whether you’re seeking stress relief or simply a peaceful escape, this treatment provides a deeply calming experience. Treat yourself to this unique service and feel completely rejuvenated.

Waxing Hair Removal

Completing our Spa treatments with hair removal in the form of waxing. We will wax any unwanted hair on your face, back, arms, and/or legs.

Where we are

We are located in the heart of Gulf Shores, Alabama, @Kneading Relief.

ABOUT

Welcome to Archer’s Gulf Serenity Spa!

Hi there, and welcome! I am so glad that you are here.

As a Licensed Massage Therapist and Licensed Cosmetologist, my mission is to provide a holistic approach to your well-being. I specialize in skin care and therapeutic massage, ensuring that every treatment is designed to nurture your body and mind.

• Massage Therapy: From relieving tension to promoting relaxation, my customized massages are tailored to your needs.

• Skincare Expertise: Whether you’re looking for rejuvenation or targeted solutions, I offer:

    •    Spa Facials

    •    Microdermabrasion

    •    HydraFacials

    •    Chemical Peels

• Japanese Head Spa Treatments: Discover the ultimate relaxation with this luxurious treatment that focuses on restoring balance to your scalp, hair, and mind. Combining time-honored Japanese techniques with modern wellness practices, this experience includes a soothing scalp massage, deep cleansing, hydration, and steam therapy using dōTERRA’s Shinrin-Yoku essential oil blend. It’s the perfect way to rejuvenate from head to soul!

 • Why We Love dōTERRA: Every service at Archer’s Gulf Serenity Spa is enhanced with dōTERRA products, chosen for their unmatched quality and commitment to purity. These essential oils and products not only elevate your experience, but also offer incredible wellness benefits that go beyond the treatment room. From soothing aromatics to nurturing your skin, dōTERRA helps us create a spa experience that’s truly transformative.

Each service is crafted to enhance your overall wellness, leaving you glowing, renewed, and relaxed.

Your wellness journey is my passion, and I’m honored to be a part of it. Ready to take some “me time”?

About Me

My name is Janna M. Archer, and I’m a proud Gulf Coast native. Born and raised here, I’ve always been captivated by the beauty and serenity of our shores. I’m honored to bring a bit of that tranquility into the services I offer.

My Inspiration

Becoming a massage therapist was driven by my passion for helping others. I’m inspired by the ability to provide relief from tension, stress, and injuries while offering a peaceful escape.

More than fifteen years later, my passion for this work remains just as strong. Massage Therapy is not only my career, but is one of my ways to help people feel their best—physically and mentally.

What Sets My Services Apart?

Every service I provide is uniquely tailored to your needs. I don’t believe in a “one-size-fits-all” approach because no two clients are the same. As part of my commitment to holistic wellness, I also incorporate dōTERRA essential oils into my practice and offer them to clients for at-home care. By focusing on your specific concerns and goals, I deliver personalized care designed to target tension, ease discomfort, and leave you feeling renewed.

I’d love the opportunity to help you find the relief and relaxation you deserve. Let’s create your perfect escape right here on the Gulf Coast!

MASSAGE
Swedish Massage Therapy
What is Swedish Massage Therapy?

As a standard massage, Swedish massage is virtually synonymous with massage therapy. In Swedish massage is based on the Western concepts of anatomy and physiology.

How does it work?

Using oil, a Swedish massage typically begin with broad general strokes and then transitions to specific problem areas.

When is a Swedish Massage especially helpful?

A Swedish massage provides full-body muscle relaxation, and it can be especially helpful if you're recovering from an injury.

How much does it cost me?

Here at Archer's Gulf Serenity Spa we offer both 60 and 90 minute treatments. A 60 minute treatment costs $100, and a 90 minute treatment is $150. A Swedish Massage focuses on more of an opportunity to relax the entire body more thoroughly, while gently focusing on any areas of pain or discomfort.

Deep Tissue Massage
What is a Deep Tissue Massage?

Deep tissue massage is a focused, therapeutic massage that targets muscle knots (also known as "adhesions") and specific problem areas in the deeper layers of muscle and connective tissue.

How does it work?

Using deliberate, slow strokes or friction across the grain of the muscle, the therapist addresses chronic tight or painful muscles, repetitive strain, postural problems, or injuries.

While it's true that the pressure of deep tissue is generally more intense than that of a Swedish massage, it shouldn't have to be painful to be effective. If you're experiencing pain, let your massage therapist know right away.

When is a Deep Tissue Massage especially helpful?

This type of massage is particularly beneficial for people with chronic pain or lingering injuries that cause limited mobility. It's effective in treating repetitive stress injuries such as tennis elbow or carpal tunnel syndrome and can be helpful in reducing the symptoms of osteoarthritis.

How much does it cost me?

Here at Archer's Gulf Serenity Spa we offer both 60 and 90 minute treatments. A 60 Minute Deep Tissue Massage, costs $100, while a 90 Minute Deep Tissue Massage will be $150.

Prenatal Massage
What is a Prenatal Massage?

Also known as pregnancy massage is customized to an expectant mother's needs but is most often used to promote relaxation. Since many pregnant women suffer from lower back pain and swollen ankles especially in the later months, prenatal massage is a relatively safe, drug-free way to provide relief.

Massage therapists who have received specialized training and are certified in prenatal massage know how to position and support the woman's body during the massage, modify techniques, and avoid certain areas and techniques during pregnancy. Most will have a special table that allows the woman to rest comfortably and safely during the massage. Ideally, you should seek out a practitioner who is experienced and licensed in prenatal massage.

How much does it cost me?

Any Prenatal Massage needs special care and training to stay attentive on the patient. Even though this is a specialty we offer any Prenatal Massage at $100 for 1 hour.

Hot Stone Massage
What is a Hot Stone Massage?

As the name implies, hot stone massage uses warm stones. The therapist places heated, smooth stones on specific points on the body and also holds the warm stones while giving the massage. The stones are usually basalt (a volcanic rock that retains heat well).

How does it work?

The warmth of the stones can be relaxing and can loosen tight muscles so that the therapist can reach areas of muscle tension quickly.

If you have certain medical conditions such as high blood pressure, diabetes, heart disease, or varicose veins, you should check with your health care provider if you plan on getting a hot stone massage. Likewise, if you take any blood-thinning medication, be sure to get a medical opinion first.

How much does it cost me?

Hot Stones can be additionally included in any massage, but for a 1 hour massage, it is $100. $150 for a 90 minute massage.

WAXING
What is Waxing?

Waxing is a method of semi-permanent hair removal which removes the hair from the root.

How long will waxing last?

Any waxing hair removal will result in new hairs not growing back for two to eight weeks. If waxing is done regularly for several years, permanent hair reduction may be achieved.

How does waxing work?

First a wax combination is spread thinly over the skin. A paper strip is then pressed on the top and ripped off with a quick movement against the direction of hair growth. This removes the wax along with the hair.

Types of Waxing we offer at our Spa

Various types of waxing are available. The different types of waxing that we offer:

Arm or Lower Leg Wax
35 Minutes • $50
This service involves either your full arm or your lower leg.
Back Wax
45 Minutes • $65
This treatment includes from waist to shoulders waxing, with some pampering thrown in there too.
Chin Wax
7 Minutes • $15
This includes the top of the chin all the way underneath, getting those hard to spot hairs.
Nose wax
7 Minutes • $15
This service includes the outside and inside of the nose.
Lip Wax
7 Minutes • $15
This includes waxing the top and bottom of your lip, followed with a calming cream.
Eyebrow Wax
10 Minutes • $20
Brow wax with calming creme to soothe afterwards.
Face Wax
30 Minutes • $65
This service includes: brows, lip, chin, and cheeks.
Benefits of Wax Hair Removal

There are many benefits to waxing versus other forms of hair removal. It is an effective method to remove large amounts of hair at one time. It is a long-lasting method. Hair in waxed areas will not grow back for two to eight weeks. When hair is shaved or removed by depilatory cream, the hair is removed at the surface rather than the root. Within a few days, the hair can be seen at the surface. With these methods, hair tends to grow back in a rough stubble. Areas that are repeatedly waxed over long periods of time often exhibit re-growth that is softer.

When should you not use wax to remove unwanted hair?

Some physicians do not recommend using wax for persons suffering from diabetes or who have varicose veins or poor circulation as they are more susceptible to infection.

Users of Retin-A, Renova, Differin or Isotretinoin are advised not to have this method performed; these medications tend to weaken the skin and tearing of the skin may occur when the wax is removed.
Waxing should not be done on areas of skin affected by warts, pimples, moles or rashes or on skin that is irritated, chapped or suffering from sunburn.

Never apply wax to peeling, broken skin or varicose veins. Women’s tolerance to pain may vary at different points in their menstrual cycle. Women may experience greater sensitivity to pain during the week before menstruation. For this reason, we recommend that women schedule appointments for the week after menstruation, when pain tolerance is generally at its highest.

Comments

When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.

Media

If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website. All images are either license free or produced by ourselves.

Contact forms
Cookies

If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

If you have an account and you log in to this site, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select “Remember Me”, your login will persist for two weeks. When you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.

Should you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.

Embedded content from other websites

Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracing your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

Analytics

We do not use any analytics tools.

Who we share your data with

We are not sharing your data with anyone.

How long we retain your data

If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically.

For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time. They are not able to change their username however. Website administrators can also see and edit that information.

What rights you have over your data

If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you,. This includes any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

Where we send your data

Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.
